messages:
oncall-bot: URGENT: Page to #incidents — SLO breach detected: p99 latency > 2.0s for canary-prod v9 on region-us-east; rolling window 5m.

lina (oncall): ack. Investigating. Paging SREs.

raj (sre): on it, pulling metrics from grafana + prometheus queries.

emily (runtime): I'm seeing streaming stalls on encoder workers, tail spikes correlate with requests > 1024 tokens. CPU on host-gpu-12 ~95%, GC pauses look small.

kai (ml): New model v9 uses longer context and extra attention layers; quantized kernels changed. Any recent kernel/driver updates?

emily (runtime): No driver changes in the last 24h. But canary config enabled "encode_parallelism": 4 for v9.

lina (oncall): can we check prefix/KV cache hit rates? If cache cold it could blow up latency.

raj (sre): cache-hit-rate: ~62% for canary, vs 89% for v8 (last 30m). Queue depth on encoder queue spiked to 940.

emily (runtime): logs snippet:
```
[13:26:02] encoder: enqueue req id=0x9f4a tokens=1600 user=cust-42
[13:26:02] encoder: start processing req id=0x9f4a worker=host-gpu-12
[13:26:03] encoder: stall detected backend=kernels timeout=120ms
[13:26:04] runtime: send retry to client id=0x9f4a
```

kai (ml): that token count + lower cache hits explains more KV lookups and longer KV fetch times. v9 has a small bug where prefix hashing misses on long contexts.

maya (product): Customer impact: two paying customers (acct-102, acct-87) showing 30% increase in request timeouts. Need mitigation now.

oliver (cs): ack, notifying CS leads and drafting canned message for affected customers. Will wait for rollback confirmation.

lina (oncall): Proposed mitigations:
- throttle canary to 0% (shift 20% back to v8)
- drain existing v9 connections gracefully
- if that fails, rollback v9 to v8

raj (sre): I can run traffic-shift: `redwood deploy traffic shift --from v9 --to v8 --percent 20 --region us-east`

emily (runtime): also restart encoder workers on host-gpu-12 and host-gpu-13 (rolling) to clear any stuck kernels.

lina (oncall): rolling restart ok? may briefly increase errors during drain.

kai (ml): if we shift traffic back, we should also disable encode_parallelism for v9 and re-run offline evals.

ops-rotation: oncall-handoff scheduled in 25m, handing to raj next.

raj (sre): executing traffic shift now. updating.

oncall-bot: ACTION: traffic-shift started by raj at 13:30 UTC — shifting 20% canary -> v8 in us-east.

raj (sre): traffic shift completed. observed p99 drop from 2.4s -> 0.9s within 60s. KV cache hit rate climbing back to 86%.

lina (oncall): nice. Emily, proceed with rolling restarts and keep an eye on streaming error rates.

emily (runtime): restarts initiated. Monitoring logs. No new customer errors reported in last 5m.

maya (product): CS to send initial update to affected customers: "We've mitigated the latency spike by shifting traffic back to the stable model; we're investigating root cause and will follow up." 

oliver (cs): sending message now.

lina (oncall): closing incident after monitoring window of 15m if stable. If any regression, escalate to infra oncall.

ops-rotation: handoff to raj in 10m.

raj (sre): ack, I'll keep monitoring until handoff. filing follow-up bug for kv-prefix hashing in v9 (tag: ml/runtime).
